fichas.title: Room Acoustics
fichas.summary: Explains room-acoustic design for speech and music, focusing on reverberation time, sound absorption, echo criteria, speech intelligibility, and spatial impression. Gives the Sabine formula, optimal reverberation-time ranges by room use, specific-volume guidance, and reflection-delay criteria.
spaces: Rooms for oratorios and symphonic music
uses: Optimizing listening conditions for speech or music
Assessing reverberation time and sound absorption
